stories.headline: Elon Musk Is Now the World's First Trillionaire. For Tesla Shareholders, the More Important Question Is What Comes Next.

stories.headline: House Republicans rally around regional Fed banks
stories.body: Lawmakers from both parties defended regional Federal Reserve banks against potential consolidation, arguing local economic perspectives are essential to ensure monetary policy remains sound.

stories.headline: 3 Identity Trends Pushing KYC Beyond Compliance
stories.body: Compliance executives have traditionally evaluated identity programs by asking whether they satisfied regulators and prevented fraud. But PYMNTS Intelligence research, done in collaboration with Trulioo, indicates that the way companies organize know your customer (KYC), know your business (KYB) and emerging know your agent (KYA) functions can affect operating costs, approval rates and expansion opportunities
